author: Glink
description:
In this Field Report, we head to Collect-A-Con Atlanta with streamers turned vendors Nick White, Nick Lee, and Ice Poseidon to find out where the money in Pokémon cards really comes from. From PSA 10 slabs and Legendary Collection reverse holos to a six-figure deal brokered on the show floor, we follow the trainers betting their lives on this market, and the rival convinced it’s about to crash.

Is the Pokémon card market a bubble or a boom? Is the value real or imaginary? And why would a generation put its money into cardboard instead of crypto, NFTs, or the stock market?

Featuring: Nick White, Nick Lee, Ice Poseidon, Gucciho (The PokeTrap), Dtan, AsianNoah, iDuncle
